title: Diwali Celebration in SF
description: Join fellow Hoyas for Diwali in SF: cocktails at Golden Eye Social, then the Bhangra & Beats Street Fair at Yerba Buena Gardens.
long_description:
Join fellow Hoyas for Diwali in SF: cocktails at Golden Eye Social, then the Bhangra & Beats Street Fair at Yerba Buena Gardens.

About this Event

Come celebrate Diwali with your fellow Bay Area Hoyas. We're starting the evening at Golden Eye Social with South Asian inspired cocktails, then heading over to the Bhangra & Beats Street Fair at Yerba Buena Gardens. Expect DJ sets, Bhangra, South Asian street food, sips, and shopping booths.
This is a relaxed way to catch up with other alumni and mark the Festival of Lights together. Bring a friend, bring your appetite, and come ready for a good time out in the city.
Pre-register and you'll be entered in a raffle for Hoya swag and Diwali prizes. We'll see you there. Hoya Saxa.

Also check out other Festivals in San Francisco.
